label: Bible Study
prompt: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with _____.
verse: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.
note: The room shook after they prayed — and they went right on preaching boldly.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: My tabernacle also shall be with them: yea, I will be their God, and they shall be my _____.
verse: My tabernacle also shall be with them: yea, I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
note: God's tabernacle among them: I will be their God, they shall be my people — the covenant in one sentence.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the _____ of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.
verse: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.
note: The early church saw so many healings that people lined the streets hoping Peter's shadow would fall on them.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But now thy kingdom shall not continue: the LORD hath sought him a man after his own _____, and the LORD hath commanded him to be captain over his people, because thou hast not kept that which the LORD commanded thee.
verse: But now thy kingdom shall not continue: the LORD hath sought him a man after his own heart, and the LORD hath commanded him to be captain over his people, because thou hast not kept that which the LORD commanded thee.
note: Samuel tells Saul his dynasty is over — God has already picked a successor who's still out keeping sheep.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I _____ my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.
verse: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.
note: Jesus' last words in Luke echo Psalm 31:5: 'into thy hands I commend my spirit.'
